_comment: Copy to daily/config.json, then fill in the fields below. recipient_user_id is the Slack user ID (starts with U) of the person who should RECEIVE the DMs — usually Jennifer Hynes (or your primary demo persona). Each sender email MUST be a persona you authorized via auth_user.py — keys under 'users' in tokens.json. timezone is any IANA name (America/Los_Angeles, America/New_York, Europe/London, etc.). slots are HH:MM in 24h, recipient-local time. weekdays may be trimmed if you only want some days.
